content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To create a dailyme customized news digest, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Design newsletter layout templates (4 hours)
Step 2. Research trending hashtags (1 hour)
Step 3. Compile list of international news agencies (2 hours)
Step 4. Screen articles for political bias (3 hours)
Step 5. Draft the weekly editorial note (2 hours)
Step 6. Categorize tech industry updates (1 hour)
Step 7. Select high-resolution cover images (30 minutes)
Step 8. Fact-check primary source claims (5 hours)
Step 9. Translate headlines into three languages (4 hours)
Step 10. Write short summaries for the "Briefs" section (2 hours)
Step 11. Reach out to freelance journalists for quotes (2 days)
Step 12. Index the lifestyle and wellness section (1 hour)
Step 13. Curate a "Quote of the Day" selection (30 minutes)
Step 14. Gather financial market closing data (1 hour)
Step 15. Review sports scores and highlights (1 hour)
Step 16. Proofread the entertainment column (45 minutes)
Step 17. Verify external hyperlinks for broken connections (2 hours)
Step 18. Format the final mobile-responsive view (1 hour)
Step 19. Send the digest to the automated distribution server (15 minutes)
Step 20. Filter content based on user preference tags (1 hour)
Step 21. Pull data from weather forecasting APIs (10 minutes)
Step 22. Tag articles with relevant metadata (2 hours)
Step 23. Insert advertisement placeholders (30 minutes)
Step 24. Optimize images for fast web loading (1 hour)
Step 25. Select the "Editor's Choice" featured story (30 minutes)
Step 26. Scrub duplicate stories from different feeds (1 hour)
Step 27. Analyze yesterday's reader engagement metrics (2 hours)
Step 28. Monitor global RSS feeds for breaking news (3 hours)
Step 29. Generate personalized subject lines (30 minutes)
Step 30. Conduct A/B testing on call-to-action buttons (3 hours)
Step 31. Summarize long-form investigative pieces (6 hours)
Step 32. Create infographics for data-heavy stories (4 hours)
Step 33. Sort articles by reading time estimates (1 hour)
Step 34. Apply SEO keywords to article descriptions (2 hours)
Step 35. Arrange the "Most Popular" sidebar content (1 hour)
Step 36. Cross-reference stories with user location data (1 hour)
Step 37. Select trending social media comments to include (2 hours)
Step 38. Draft the "On This Day" historical snippet (1 hour)
Step 39. Source copyright-free icons for categories (1 hour)
Step 40. Update the "Meet the Team" footer (30 minutes)
Step 41. Identify top stories in the science and nature sector (2 hours)
Step 42. Verify the newsletter's dark mode compatibility (1 hour)
Step 43. Run a final spam filter check (15 minutes)
Step 44. Organize the "Op-Ed" contributor section (3 hours)
Step 45. Fetch latest stock prices from the exchange (15 minutes)
Step 46. Embed video snippets into the digital version (2 hours)
Step 47. Perform a final grammar and syntax sweep (3 hours)
Step 48. Generate a table of contents with anchor links (1 hour)
Step 49. Update the user subscription database (1 hour)
Step 50. Review the legal disclaimer and privacy policy (1 hour)
Step 51. Send a preview copy to the internal testing group (30 minutes)
Step 52. Compile the "Travel and Leisure" photo gallery (2 hours)
Step 53. Select the lead headline for the front page (1 hour)
Step 54. Set the publication timestamp for the morning release (10 minutes)
Step 55. Research "Hidden Gem" local businesses (3 hours)
Step 56. Integrate interactive polls for readers (2 hours)
Step 57. Set up the newsletter's backend architecture (1 day)
Step 58. Adjust font sizes for accessibility compliance (1 hour)
Step 59. Archive the previous day's edition (30 minutes)
Step 60. Conduct a final tone-of-voice consistency check (2 hours)
Step 61. Balance the distribution of text and visuals (2 hours)
Step 62. Write captivating teaser text for social media (2 hours)
Step 63. Create a summary of local community events (2 hours)
Step 64. Identify the most engaging topics from the morning (2 hours)
Step 65. Set up the tracking pixels for analytics (1 hour)
Step 66. Adjust the whitespace for better readability (1 hour)
Step 67. Review the feedback from the "Letters to the Editor" (2 hours)
Step 68. Select a color palette based on the daily theme (1 hour)
Step 69. Clean up the HTML/CSS code for the email body (2 hours)
Step 70. Fetch the daily horoscope data (30 minutes)
Step 71. Generate the "Daily Puzzle" or crossword (1 hour)
Step 72. Link the newsletter to the main website's archive (1 hour)
Step 73. Check the "Events Calendar" for date accuracy (1 hour)
Step 74. Select the "Podcast of the Day" recommendation (1 hour)
Step 75. Gather the "Top 5 Recipes" for the food section (2 hours)
Step 76. Aggregate the "New Books" release list (2 hours)
Step 77. Perform a multi-browser rendering test (2 hours)
Step 78. Finalize the "Weekend Preview" special insert (3 hours)
Step 79. Verify the "Unsubscribe" link functionality (30 minutes)
Step 80. Configure the server's load balancing for high traffic (4 hours)
